mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sell_order (inbound_detail_id, account_id, foreign_product_id, sell_qty, base_price, settlement_fx_rate, status, processed_at) VALUES (#{inboundDetailId}, #{accountId}, #{foreignProductId}, #{sellQty}, #{basePrice}, #{settlementFxRate}, #{status}, #{processedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sell_qty * base_price), 0) FROM sell_order WHERE processed_at >= #{start} AND processed_at < #{end} AND status IN ('RECEIVED', 'EXECUTED')

where.if: AND (acc.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT s.sell_qty, s.base_price, s.processed_at, s.status, krw.provisional_amount, krw.final_amount, acc.account_no, c.name AS customerName, fp.ticker, fp.name AS name FROM sell_order s LEFT JOIN krw_exchange krw ON krw.order_id = s.order_id LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = s.account_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = acc.customer_id LEFT JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = s.foreign_product_id
ORDER BY s.processed_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sell_order s LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = s.account_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = acc.customer_id
